```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ipeds <- readRDS("~/work/data/ipeds_state_na_rm.RDS")
dict_sub <- readRDS("~/work/data/dict_sub2.RDS")
```

```{r}
summary(ipeds$out_state_pct)
hist(ipeds$out_state_pct)


ipeds$out_group <- with(ipeds,ifelse(out_state_pct <= .05, 0,
                                     ifelse(out_state_pct <= .2813,1,
                                            ifelse(out_state_pct <= 0.4860,2,3))))
ipeds$out_group <- factor(ipeds$out_group, labels = c("0-5%","Low","Medium","High"))

table(ipeds$out_group, useNA = "always")
```


```{r}
ipeds %>%
  subset(!is.na(out_group)&!is.na(ADM_RATE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=out_group, y = ADM_RATE))+
  geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
degreelabs <- dict_sub%>%
  filter(grepl("PCIP", `VARIABLE NAME`))%>%
  select(c(`VARIABLE NAME`,LABEL))

degrees <- ipeds %>%
  subset(!is.na(out_group))%>%
  select(c(UnitID,out_group,INSTNM,CITY,STABBR,ADM_RATE,total,out_state_pct,PCIP01:PCIP54))%>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("PCIP"),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Proportion"
  )

degrees_sum <- degrees %>%
  group_by(out_group, Category) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_proportion = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

degrees_sum <- merge(degrees_sum, degreelabs, by.x = "Category", by.y="VARIABLE NAME",all.x = TRUE)
```


```{r,fig.width=8in}
ggplot(degrees_sum,
       aes(y = LABEL,
           x = out_group,
           fill = mean_proportion)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Mean Proportion"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Program Category",
    y = "Group"
  ) +
  # scale_y_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(50))+
  theme_minimal()+
    theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(vjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
categorical <- subset(dict_sub,grepl("program.bachelors.", `developer-friendly name`, fixed = TRUE))$`VARIABLE NAME`
prop <- subset(dict_sub,grepl("PCIP", `VARIABLE NAME`, fixed = TRUE))$`VARIABLE NAME`
covariates <- c("STUFACR",
"GRADS",
"UGDS",
"UGDS_MEN",
"UGDS_WOMEN",
"UG12MN",
"TUITIONFEE_OUT",
"TUITIONFEE_IN",
prop,
"ADM_RATE",
"SATVR75",
"SATMT75",
categorical
)

formula <- reformulate(covariates, response = "out_state_pct")

fit <- lm(formula, data = ipeds)
summary(fit)
```
